title: Qwen3.5 bounded-reasoning quality frontier
hypothesis: A small forced-end reasoning budget can recover at least three of Qwen3.5-4B Q4_0's immediate-answer misses while keeping median same-text latency below the frozen five-second cloud ceiling on Arm.
selection_basis: The separately frozen E3d run measured stable immediate-answer Q4_0 output and approximately 40 milliseconds per generated token before its runtime-proof harness gate. The pinned current llama.cpp exposes a reasoning-budget sampler that forces the model's end-of-thinking sequence after an exact token count. Budgets through 48 tokens were selected from latency evidence before any thinking-mode output was observed.
controlled_difference: Every candidate uses the identical Qwen3.5-4B Q4_0 file, current llama.cpp and KleidiAI revisions, tasks, parser, prompt, deterministic sampling, thread count, context, and host. Only the enforced reasoning-token budget and its corresponding output cap differ.

quality.prediction_parser: first standalone uppercase A-D after case folding
